destinations.entry_condition: Wait for portfolio cash > 22.0% and VRTX pullback into $518.99-$534.79 support.

destinations.recommendation: No outside equity funded during Downtrend cash-rebuild phase.

primer: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN) earns a COMPOUNDER_PASS business-quality rating but a REJECTED (TIER_0) new-capital verdict on VALUATION and TREND. At $936.56 in the live snapshot ($920.69 on November 20), shares sit 12.48% above the 50-day SMA in a Downtrend tape with only 0.50:1 reward-to-risk to our $1,035.00 base fair value against the $741.50 stop. With zero shares held and portfolio cash at 3.38% versus a 22.0% Downtrend floor, we stand aside and preserve cash.
